name: Kosmos-1614
about: Kosmos-1614 (1984-126A), a crewed vehicle (BOR-4), launched 1984 Dec 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Dec 19), held fixed
GCAT names the site (Black Sea) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
